integrity: The proof uses the published irredundant facet description as an input, then derives the inradius by symmetry reduction and exact facet distances, proves uniqueness from the active shrunken facets, and derives the circumradius from the exact distance profile of matching vertices. The finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical edge-incidence realization of the matching polytope of the complete graph. It does not extend the closed formulas to arbitrary graphs or to affine images, and the originality assessment cannot exclude unindexed equivalent formulations.
title: Exact Euclidean radii and contact-facet phase of complete-graph matching polytopes
